summary.intent: Review and update codebase documentation, identify E2E testing gaps from FEATURES.md, capture todos for improvements, add new roadmap phases for technical debt resolution, and run a phase discussion for Phase 28 (Code Hygiene & Logging).
summary.outcome: Created 6 GSD todos for E2E and staging testing work, added 5 new roadmap phases (28-32) targeting technical debt, completed Phase 28 context discussion with logger design decision (custom wrapper over pino/browser), and created PRs #380 and #381. Main branch was updated with a major GSD tooling upgrade mid-session.

repo: Only recovery.spec.ts (1 of 12 specs) calls deleteTestAccount() in teardown — 11 specs leave orphaned test accounts. A deleteTestAccount() helper already exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts.

AES-CTR streaming uses CTR mode for media files >256KB and GCM for everything else, implemented in streaming-crypto.service.ts. The service worker in decrypt-sw.ts handles HTTP Range requests for seeking with BigInt counter math.
35 unit tests exist in packages/crypto for AES-CTR streaming, but zero E2E tests — Phase 12.1 left a human verification checklist that was never automated.
139 console.* calls exist across 29 files in apps/web/src/ (82 error, 27 warn, 18 log, 12 time/timeEnd). The biggest offender is hooks.ts with 34 calls (Web3Auth debug logging).

11 .catch(() => {}) patterns on unpinFromIpfs calls exist across bin.service.ts, useFileOperations.ts, useFileVersions.ts, ReplaceFileDialog.tsx, useDropUpload.ts. 3 non-unpin catches (audioContext.close(), dynamic import) should be left alone.
00-Preliminary-R&D/poc/ contains 89MB of committed node_modules with deprecated ipfs-http-client@60.0.1 — already excluded from ESLint.
Pino browser mode lacks redaction support (Node.js only) and its Sentry integration is also Node.js only, making it unsuitable for Phase 30 observability integration in the web app.
STATE.md todo count can become stale across sessions — the count was already showing 10 before the session started, causing a miscalculation when adding 4 new todos.

code.finding: Contains deleteTestAccount() helper that calls DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' } — not wired into most spec afterAll hooks
CTR mode selection logic: >256KB files use AES-CTR, smaller files use GCM
Service worker intercepts /decrypt-stream/* URLs and handles HTTP Range requests for media seeking
1199-line hook with zero unit tests — highest-risk fragile area identified in CONCERNS.md
Already uses import.meta.env.DEV for conditional gating — good pattern to follow for logger level filtering via VITE_LOG_LEVEL

workflow: When STATE.md shows a pending todo count, always verify it with a directory listing before incrementing — stale counts cause off-by-N errors.
ROADMAP.md wildcard characters (console.*) get escaped to console.\* by linters/pre-commit hooks, which breaks gsd-tools.cjs JSON parsing of the roadmap.
GSD discuss-phase assumptions mode can be enhanced mid-flow by spawning a research subagent to compare library options (pino vs wrapper) before locking decisions.
The manager workflow's JSON init can fail if ROADMAP.md contains escaped regex metacharacters — needs a fix in gsd-tools.cjs or ROADMAP.md authoring conventions.

friction: STATE.md todo count was stale (showed 10 when actual was 6), causing assistant to output '6 → 14' instead of '6 → 10', requiring a correction and re-commit.
gsd-tools.cjs init manager failed to parse ROADMAP.md because a pre-commit hook or linter escaped 'console.*' to 'console.\*' in the roadmap text, requiring a manual fix and extra commit.
Manager dashboard refresh loop required multiple bash attempts to get valid JSON from gsd-tools.cjs due to the ROADMAP escape issue.
